versos.grego: Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοὶ καὶ πατέρες, ἀκούσατέ μου τῆς πρὸς ὑμᾶς νυνὶ ἀπολογίας.

controles.web: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”
controles.kjv: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.
controles.livre: Homens irmãos, e pais, ouvi agora minha defesa para convosco.

versos.grego: —ἀκούσαντες δὲ ὅτι τῇ Ἑβραΐδι διαλέκτῳ προσεφώνει αὐτοῖς μᾶλλον παρέσχον ἡσυχίαν. καὶ φησίν—

controles.web: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,
controles.kjv: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)
controles.livre: E tendo ouvido que ele lhes falava em língua hebraica, fizeram ainda mais silêncio. E ele disse:

versos.grego: Ἐγώ εἰμι ἀνὴρ Ἰουδαῖος, γεγεννημένος ἐν Ταρσῷ τῆς Κιλικίας, ἀνατεθραμμένος δὲ ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ, παρὰ τοὺς πόδας Γαμαλιήλ πεπαιδευμένος κατὰ ἀκρίβειαν τοῦ πατρῴου νόμου, ζηλωτὴς ὑπάρχων τοῦ Θεοῦ καθὼς πάντες ὑμεῖς ἐστε σήμερον·

controles.web: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are this day.
controles.kjv: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.
controles.livre: Eu verdadeiramente sou um homem judeu, nascido em Tarso da Cilícia, e criado nesta cidade aos pés de Gamaliel, ensinado ao mais correto modo da Lei paterna e zeloso de Deus, assim como todos vós sois hoje.

versos.grego: ὃς ταύτην τὴν Ὁδὸν ἐδίωξα ἄχρι θανάτου, δεσμεύων καὶ παραδιδοὺς εἰς φυλακὰς ἄνδρας τε καὶ γυναῖκας,

controles.web: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
controles.kjv: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
controles.livre: Eu ,que persegui este caminho até a morte, atando tanto a homens como a mulheres, e os entregando a prisões.

versos.grego: ὡς καὶ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς μαρτυρεῖ μοι καὶ πᾶν τὸ πρεσβυτέριον· παρ’ ὧν καὶ ἐπιστολὰς δεξάμενος πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς εἰς Δαμασκὸν ἐπορευόμην, ἄξων καὶ τοὺς ἐκεῖσε ὄντας δεδεμένους εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἵνα τιμωρηθῶσιν.

controles.web: As also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.
controles.kjv: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.
controles.livre: Assim como também o sumo sacerdote me é testemunha, e todo o conselho dos anciãos; dos quais eu, tendo tomado cartas para os irmãos, fui a Damasco para que os que estivessem ali, eu também os trouxesse amarrados a Jerusalém, para que fossem castigados.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δέ μοι πορευομένῳ καὶ ἐγγίζοντι τῇ Δαμασκῷ περὶ μεσημβρίαν ἐξαίφνης ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ περιαστράψαι φῶς ἱκανὸν περὶ ἐμέ,

controles.web: As I made my journey, and came close to Damascus, about noon, suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
controles.livre: Mas aconteceu que, estando eu no caminho, e chegando perto de Damasco, quase ao meio dia, de repente uma grande luz do céu brilhou ao redor de mim.

versos.grego: ἔπεσά τε εἰς τὸ ἔδαφος καὶ ἤκουσα φωνῆς λεγούσης μοι Σαοὺλ Σαούλ, τί με διώκεις;

controles.web: I fell to the ground, and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
controles.kjv: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
controles.livre: Eu cai ao chão, e ouvi uma voz, que me dizia: Saulo, Saulo, por que me persegues?

versos.grego: ἐγὼ δὲ ἀπεκρίθην Τίς εἶ, Κύριε; εἶπέν τε πρὸς ἐμέ Ἐγώ εἰμι Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζωραῖος, ὃν σὺ διώκεις.

controles.web: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’
controles.kjv: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.
controles.livre: E eu respondi: Quem és, Senhor? E ele me disse: Eu sou Jesus, o nazareno, a quem tu persegues.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ σὺν ἐμοὶ ὄντες τὸ μὲν φῶς ἐθεάσαντο, τὴν δὲ φωνὴν οὐκ ἤκουσαν τοῦ λαλοῦντός μοι.

controles.web: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.
controles.kjv: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.
controles.livre: E os que estavam comigo verdadeiramente viram a luz, e ficaram muito atemorizados; mas eles não ouviram a voz daquele que falava comigo.

versos.grego: εἶπον δέ Τί ποιήσω, Κύριε; ὁ δὲ Κύριος εἶπεν πρός με Ἀναστὰς πορεύου εἰς Δαμασκόν, κἀκεῖ σοι λαληθήσεται περὶ πάντων ὧν τέτακταί σοι ποιῆσαι.

controles.web: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’
controles.kjv: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.
controles.livre: E eu disse: Que farei, Senhor? E o Senhor me disse: Levanta-te, e vai a Damasco, e ali te será dito tudo o que te é ordenado fazer.

versos.grego: ὡς δὲ οὐκ ἐνέβλεπον ἀπὸ τῆς δόξης τοῦ φωτὸς ἐκείνου, χειραγωγούμενος ὑπὸ τῶν συνόντων μοι ἦλθον εἰς Δαμασκόν.

controles.web: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.
controles.kjv: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.
controles.livre: E quando eu não conseguia ver, por causa da glória daquela luz, eu fui levado pela mão dos que estavam comigo, e assim cheguei a Damasco.

versos.grego: Ἀνανίας δέ τις ἀνὴρ εὐλαβὴς κατὰ τὸν νόμον, μαρτυρούμενος ὑπὸ πάντων τῶν κατοικούντων Ἰουδαίων,

controles.web: One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,
controles.kjv: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,
controles.livre: E um certo Ananias, homem devoto conforme a Lei, que tinha bom testemunho de todos os judeus que moravam ali ;

versos.grego: ἐλθὼν πρὸς ἐμὲ καὶ ἐπιστὰς εἶπέν μοι Σαοὺλ ἀδελφέ, ἀνάβλεψον. κἀγὼ αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἀνέβλεψα εἰς αὐτόν.

controles.web: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.
controles.kjv: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.
controles.livre: Tendo vindo até mim, e ficando diante de mim ,ele me disse: Irmão Saulo, recupere a vista; E naquela mesma hora eu pude vê-lo.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ὁ Θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν προεχειρίσατό σε γνῶναι τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἰδεῖν τὸν Δίκαιον καὶ ἀκοῦσαι φωνὴν ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.
controles.kjv: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.
controles.livre: E ele disse: O Deus de nossos pais te predeterminou para que tu conheças a vontade dele, e vejas aquele justo, e tu ouças a voz de sua boca.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἔσῃ μάρτυς αὐτῷ πρὸς πάντας ἀνθρώπους ὧν ἑώρακας καὶ ἤκουσας.

controles.web: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.
controles.kjv: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.
controles.livre: Porque tu serás testemunha dele para com todos as pessoas, daquilo que tens visto e ouvido.

versos.grego: καὶ νῦν τί μέλλεις; ἀναστὰς βάπτισαι καὶ ἀπόλουσαι τὰς ἁμαρτίας σου, ἐπικαλεσάμενος τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’
controles.kjv: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
controles.livre: E agora, por que estás parado? Levanta-te, e sê batizado, e lava teus pecados, invocando o nome do Senhor.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δέ μοι ὑποστρέψαντι εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ καὶ προσευχομένου μου ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ γενέσθαι με ἐν ἐκστάσει

controles.web: “When I had returned to Jerusalem, and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance,
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;
controles.livre: E aconteceu a mim, tendo eu voltado a Jerusalém, e estando orando no Templo, veio-me um êxtase;

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδεῖν αὐτὸν λέγοντά μοι Σπεῦσον καὶ ἔξελθε ἐν τάχει ἐξ Ἱερουσαλήμ, διότι οὐ παραδέξονταί σου μαρτυρίαν περὶ ἐμοῦ.

controles.web: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’
controles.kjv: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.
controles.livre: E eu vi aquele que me dizia: Apressa-te, e sai logo de Jerusalém, porque não aceitarão teu testemunho sobre mim.

versos.grego: κἀγὼ εἶπον Κύριε, αὐτοὶ ἐπίστανται ὅτι ἐγὼ ἤμην φυλακίζων καὶ δέρων κατὰ τὰς συναγωγὰς τοὺς πιστεύοντας ἐπὶ σέ·

controles.web: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.
controles.kjv: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
controles.livre: E eu disse: Senhor, eles sabem que eu prendia e açoitava nas sinagogas aqueles que criam em ti.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅτε ἐξεχύννετο τὸ αἷμα Στεφάνου τοῦ μάρτυρός σου, καὶ αὐτὸς ἤμην ἐφεστὼς καὶ συνευδοκῶν καὶ φυλάσσων τὰ ἱμάτια τῶν ἀναιρούντων αὐτόν.

controles.web: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’
controles.kjv: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
controles.livre: E quando o sangue de Estêvão, tua testemunha, se derramava, eu também estava presente, e consentia em sua morte, e guardava as roupas daqueles que o matavam.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν πρός με Πορεύου, ὅτι ἐγὼ εἰς ἔθνη μακρὰν ἐξαποστελῶ σε.

controles.web: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’”
controles.kjv: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.
controles.livre: E ele me disse: Vai, porque eu te enviarei para longe, aos gentios.

versos.grego: Ἤκουον δὲ αὐτοῦ ἄχρι τούτου τοῦ λόγου, καὶ ἐπῆραν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτῶν λέγοντες Αἶρε ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς τὸν τοιοῦτον· οὐ γὰρ καθῆκεν αὐτὸν ζῆν.

controles.web: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice, and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”
controles.kjv: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.
controles.livre: E eles o ouviram até esta palavra, e em seguida levantaram suas vozes, dizendo: Extermina-o da terra! Porque não é bom que ele viva.

versos.grego: κραυγαζόντων τε αὐτῶν καὶ ῥιπτούντων τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ κονιορτὸν βαλλόντων εἰς τὸν ἀέρα,

controles.web: As they cried out, and threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,
controles.kjv: And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,
controles.livre: E enquanto eles gritavam, tiravam suas capas, e lançavm pó ao ar,

versos.grego: ἐκέλευσεν ὁ χιλίαρχος εἰσάγεσθαι αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν, εἴπας μάστιξιν ἀνετάζεσθαι αὐτὸν, ἵνα ἐπιγνῷ δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν οὕτως ἐπεφώνουν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.
controles.kjv: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.
controles.livre: O comandante mandou que o levassem à área fortificada, dizendo que o interrogassem com açoites, para saber por que causa clamavam assim contra ele.

versos.grego: ὡς δὲ προέτειναν αὐτὸν τοῖς ἱμᾶσιν, εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν ἑστῶτα ἑκατόνταρχον ὁ Παῦλος Εἰ ἄνθρωπον Ῥωμαῖον καὶ ἀκατάκριτον ἔξεστιν ὑμῖν μαστίζειν;

controles.web: When they had tied him up with thongs, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”
controles.kjv: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?
controles.livre: E quando estavam o atando com correias, Paulo disse ao centurião que estava ali: É lícito para vós açoitar a um homem romano, sem ter sido condenado?

versos.grego: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ ἑκατοντάρχης προσελθὼν τῷ χιλιάρχῳ ἀπήγγειλεν λέγων Τί μέλλεις ποιεῖν; ὁ γὰρ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος Ῥωμαῖός ἐστιν.

controles.web: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”
controles.kjv: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.
controles.livre: E o centurião, tendo ouvido isto ,foi e avisou ao comandante, dizendo: Olha o que estás a ponto de fazer, porque este homem é romano.

versos.grego: προσελθὼν δὲ ὁ χιλίαρχος εἶπεν αὐτῷ Λέγε μοι, σὺ Ῥωμαῖος εἶ; ὁ δὲ ἔφη Ναί.

controles.web: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?”   He said, “Yes.”
controles.kjv: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.
controles.livre: E o comandante, tendo se aproximado, disse-lhe: Dize-me, tu és romano?E ele disse: Sim.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ ὁ χιλίαρχος Ἐγὼ πολλοῦ κεφαλαίου τὴν πολιτείαν ταύτην ἐκτησάμην. ὁ δὲ Παῦλος ἔφη Ἐγὼ δὲ καὶ γεγέννημαι.

controles.web: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.”   Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”
controles.kjv: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.
controles.livre: E o comandante respondeu: Eu com muita soma de dinheiro obtive esta cidadania romana .E Paulo disse: E eu a tenho desde que nasci.

versos.grego: εὐθέως οὖν ἀπέστησαν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ οἱ μέλλοντες αὐτὸν ἀνετάζειν· καὶ ὁ χιλίαρχος δὲ ἐφοβήθη ἐπιγνοὺς ὅτι Ῥωμαῖός ἐστιν καὶ ὅτι αὐτὸν ἦν δεδεκώς.

controles.web: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.
controles.kjv: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
controles.livre: Então logo se afastaram dele aqueles que estavam para interrogá-lo; e até o comandante teve temor, ao entender que Paulo era romano, e que tinha o atado.

versos.grego: Τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον βουλόμενος γνῶναι τὸ ἀσφαλὲς, τὸ τί κατηγορεῖται ὑπὸ τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ἔλυσεν αὐτόν, καὶ ἐκέλευσεν συνελθεῖν τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ πᾶν τὸ συνέδριον, καὶ καταγαγὼν τὸν Παῦλον ἔστησεν εἰς αὐτούς.

controles.web: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds, and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.
controles.kjv: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.
controles.livre: E n o dia seguinte, querendo saber corretamente a causa de por que ele era acusado pelos judeus, ele o soltou das correntes, e mandou vir aos chefes dos sacerdotes e todo o Supremo Conselho deles; e tendo trazido a Paulo, apresentou -o diante deles.
